question.text: The TWS (Trader Workstation) provides which two kinds of information?

answer.text: Trading member's own transaction information AND market information
Client personal information and trade details

explanation.text: The Logic: TWS provides two categories of information: (1) the trading member's own transaction information - orders, modifications, outstanding orders, order log, trade details; and (2) market information - order book, price info, trade info, and other market data. The Trap: TWS shows both personal trading data AND market-wide data, not just one of the two. Note: Exchanges also provide spot market currency price feeds through TWS to assist in trading decisions.
